Notes: The nave is covered in punched windows, but the real walls are mostly solid travertine with only a few arched openings, so I removed them from the nave, apse and back towers. The front facade and portico are too low and flat, so I raised the facade and gave the equestrian statues proper height and mass. The main dome, drum and lantern are too small for the building, so I enlarged the drum and dome and thickened the lantern, and the flanking domes are larger too.
